title: Blast Radius
description: Who is exposed to a vulnerability — the users and network locations that downloaded an affected artifact, and how widely each affected repository is reachable.
accessDeniedDescription: You must be an administrator to view CVE blast-radius reports.
cveIdError: Enter a CVE id like CVE-2021-44228 (GHSA ids are accepted too)
artifactIdError: Artifact ID must be a UUID
pickTargetDescription: Enter a CVE id (or switch to artifact mode and enter an artifact id) to see who downloaded the affected artifacts and which repositories expose them. You can also open this page from a scan finding's advisory link.
unavailableDescription: Unable to load the blast-radius report. This server may not support the blast-radius endpoints yet, or the request failed.
noAffectedRepos: No repositories hold an affected artifact.
noDownloaders: No downloads of affected artifacts recorded.
latentDescription: Users who could read an affected artifact but have not downloaded it. This is potential reach, not confirmed exposure — the downloaders above are who actually pulled the artifact.
latentUnavailableDescription: Unable to load the accessible-but-not-downloaded report. This server may not support the accessible-users endpoint yet, or the request failed.
noLatentAccess: No users have latent access without a recorded download.
publicRepoAlertDescription: This artifact lives in an anonymous-readable repository, so every user (and unauthenticated clients) can reach it. A per-user list is not applicable.
tooBroadAlertTitle: Access is too broad to enumerate
tooBroadAlertDescription: So many principals can reach this artifact that a per-user list is not meaningful. Tighten the repository's access scope to narrow the latent blast radius.
